title: Mystery as eerie lights over Ipswich spark UFO theories from baffled locals
excerpt: Mysterious lights over Ipswich sparked alien theories, but were confirmed as Illuminate Ipswich installations at Christchurch Park.
content:
Strange lights over Ipswich confirmed as Illuminate event

Mysterious lights over Ipswich have left locals baffled (Image: Supplied)

This article is brought to you by our exclusive subscriber partnership with our sister title USA Today, and has been written by our American colleagues. It does not necessarily reflect the view of The Herald.

Strange lights in the skies over Ipswich have left locals baffled.

The white, octagonally shaped visions were spotted by a man living near Christchurch Park at around 5.45pm on Thursday.

While initially looking quite rounded, they then opened up to become more elongated, before moving across the sky.

The sight has caused a stir on social media, with many around Ipswich flocking to Facebook with theories about what the mysterious lights could be.

"Definitely the aliens," one person commented.

"Dalek mothership!" another said.

However, the source of the lights has now been confirmed as the Illuminate Ipswich event at Christchurch Park.

Now in its third year, other locals are getting used to the unfamiliar and strange lights and many were quick to quiet the rumours when speculation started online.

Illuminate is a ticketed event that runs every day (other than Christmas Day) until January 1.

This year's event at Christchurch Park has a completely new route, a fresh layout and light installations that have never been seen before at any of the former Ipswich events.
